outcome: Adherence to pulmonary therapies (airway clearance, aerosolized medications)
Clinical personas related to adherence barriers
cohort: The study included 87 parent participants of children with cystic fibrosis.
finding: Parents of children with cystic fibrosis were segmented into three distinct patterns of adherence, primarily influenced by self-efficacy, distance to CF care center, and child BMI percentile, leading to the development of eight clinical personas.
cross-section timing: The study analyzed current adherence patterns and their influencing factors among parents.
